title: Police Report Regarding Arrival Of Generals Ho Ying Ching And Hsiung Shih Hwei In Shanghai 121437

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 2, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date... December 14. 19 37.
Subject... Reported arrival of Generals Ho Ying Ching and Hsiung Shih Hwei
in Shanghai.
Made by.................... and .................... Forwarded by... Superintendent Tan Shao-liang

Enquiries have failed to confirm the report that General
Ho Ying Ching, Minister of War, and General Hsiung Shih Hwei,
Chairman of the Kiangse Provincial Government, have arrived in
Shanghai to discuss peace terms with the Japanese military
leaders.    information from well informed sources indicates
that there is no likelihood of important personages like these
two men taking the risk of visiting Shanghai at the present
moment.
The rumour apparently had its origin from the fact that
General Ho Ying Ching was once pro-Japanese as he was a party
to the Ho-Umetsu agreement in Tientsin, which made it possible
for the declaration of the autonomous government in East Hopei
and that General Hsiung Shih Hwei received his education in
Japan.

Superintendent

D.C. (Special Branch)
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号............
特务科第二股，
报告
日期... 1937年12月14日。
事由... 关于何应钦将军与熊式辉将军抵沪的报告。
呈报人.................... 及 .................... 转呈人... 谭绍良警司

经查询，未能证实有关陆军部长何应钦将军与江西省政府主席熊式辉将军已抵达上海、旨在与日军将领商讨和平条款的报告。来自消息灵通人士的情报表明，像此二人这般的重要人物，在目前时刻冒险访问上海的可能性微乎其微。
该谣言的起因，显然在于何应钦将军曾表现出亲日倾向，因为他曾是天津《何梅协定》的当事方之一，该协定使得冀东自治政府的宣告成立成为可能；此外，熊式辉将军曾在日本接受教育。

警司

副警司（特务科）
